primaryChecks.text: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
primaryChecks.previousContext: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: “entrance of Gedor” is a place-name mention; it is not merged with the 12:7 target because the fixed text does not establish the same site.

primaryChecks.text: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
primaryChecks.nextContext: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
primaryChecks.decisionJa: A place-of-origin use adopted for this profile.
